task_text: Baoding balls: rotate the two balls around each other in the palm so that each follows its moving target (the targets circle the palm once every 5 s). Success: both balls within 0.015 m of their targets for 200 consecutive control steps (5.0 s: one full orbit of the targets). Failure (the episode ends): a ball's height (world z) drops below 1.25 m, i.e. it falls out of the palm.
